title: Create Landing Page Section Components
description: Develop reusable, presentational components for the landing page sections (e.g., Hero, FeatureList, CTA) under a new directory `components/landing/`.
details:
- Create a new directory: `components/landing/`.
- Implement components such as `Hero.tsx`, `FeatureList.tsx`, and `CallToAction.tsx`.
- Use `shadcn/ui` components (e.g., Button, Card) and Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Ensure all components use semantic HTML and are accessible (proper roles, alt text, keyboard navigation).
- Components should be responsive and support both light and dark themes via inherited context from the root layout.
test_strategy:
- Render each component in isolation (Storybook or test page) to verify correct appearance and responsiveness.
- Use accessibility tools (e.g., axe, Lighthouse) to check for semantic HTML and keyboard navigation.
- Manually test in light and dark modes.

title: Compose Landing Page in app/page.tsx
description: Replace the existing placeholder in `app/page.tsx` with the new landing page layout, assembling the section components created in Task 1.
details:
- Remove all placeholder content from `app/page.tsx`.
- Import and arrange the new section components (Hero, FeatureList, CallToAction, etc.) to create a visually appealing, professional landing page.
- Use semantic HTML structure (`<main>`, `<section>`, etc.).
- Ensure the layout is fully responsive and visually consistent with the dashboard's design system.
test_strategy:
- Load the root URL ('/') and verify the new landing page renders correctly on desktop and mobile.
- Check for layout issues, broken styles, or missing content.
- Confirm that the page respects the current theme (light/dark).

title: Implement Navigation to Sign In and Sign Up
description: Add clear, visually prominent CTA buttons using `shadcn/ui` components that route users to `/sign-in` and `/sign-up` using Next.js `<Link>`.
details:
- In the appropriate section (likely Hero or CallToAction), add two CTA buttons: 'Sign In' and 'Sign Up'.
- Use the `Button` component from `components/ui` for consistency.
- Wrap each button with Next.js `<Link>` to `/sign-in` and `/sign-up` respectively.
- Ensure buttons are accessible (focusable, proper aria-labels if needed).
test_strategy:
- Click each CTA button and verify navigation to the correct authentication page.
- Test keyboard navigation and focus states for accessibility.
- Confirm buttons are visually prominent and styled according to the design system.

title: Validate Responsiveness and Accessibility
description: Test the landing page for responsiveness across devices and ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA).
details:
- Manually test the landing page on various screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop).
- Use browser dev tools and accessibility checkers (axe, Lighthouse) to identify and fix issues.
- Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible and have appropriate ARIA attributes.
- Confirm color contrast and text size meet accessibility standards.
test_strategy:
- Use Chrome DevTools and device emulation to test responsiveness.
- Run automated accessibility audits and manually test keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.
